extracted.intended_audience: researchers, engineers, and prospective collaborators or job applicants interested in Amazon's research focuses
extracted.subtask_description: A company-page taxonomy describing Amazon Science's principal research areas and their goals, with example subtopics for each area. Useful for researchers deciding where their work aligns with Amazon or for applicants exploring research teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automated reasoning
rubrics_metrics.description: Focusing on the automation of formal logical reasoning to raise the bar on the security, durability, availability, and quality of Amazon’s products and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: AWS IAM Access Analyzer; Formal methods; Formal verification; Model checking; Provable security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cloud and systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing new technologies that offer increased computing power, expanded database storage, faster content delivery, and other capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Amazon SageMaker; Big data; Hardware; Security; Virtual-machine placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer vision
rubrics_metrics.description: Helping devices see and understand our visual world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: 3D modeling / imaging; Compression; Convolutional neural networks (CNNs); Multimodal interaction; Video streaming; Vision-language models (VLMs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversational AI
rubrics_metrics.description: Building software and systems that help people communicate with computers naturally, as if communicating with family and friends.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Automatic speech recognition (ASR); Dialogue; Large language models (LLMs); Natural-language processing (NLP); Natural-language understanding (NLU); Text-to-speech (TTS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Economics
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing sophisticated approaches and systems to deliver the broadest selection of products and services at the lowest prices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Demand forecasting; Econometrics; Economic models; Technology economics; Yield management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information and knowledge management
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing machine learning techniques to enrich product-related information from Amazon detail pages and the Internet at large.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Data mining; Graph neural networks (GNNs); Knowledge discovery; Knowledge graphs; Text mining.

rubrics_metrics.name: Machine learning
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing algorithms and statistical models that computer systems use to perform tasks without explicit instructions, relying on patterns and inference instead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Bayesian optimization; Multi-armed bandits; Reinforcement learning; Responsible AI; Time series.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operations research and optimization
rubrics_metrics.description: Streamlining operations to deliver orders to you faster, more conveniently, and more economically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Inventory planning; Last-mile delivery; Middle mile; Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT); Transportation planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantum technologies
rubrics_metrics.description: By harnessing the laws of quantum physics, quantum computers have the potential to solve problems that are beyond the reach of today's computers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: AWS Center for Quantum Computing; Quantum computing; Quantum error correction; Quantum hardware; Quantum mechanics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robotics
rubrics_metrics.description: Delivering a more convenient and consistent customer experience through a variety of technologies, including autonomous mobile robots, sophisticated control software, language perception, power management, computer vision, depth sensing, machine learning, object recognition, and semantic understanding of commands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Autonomous robotics; Human-robot interaction; Mobile robotics; Robotic automation; Robotic manipulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search and information retrieval
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing advanced techniques to analyze behavioral patterns, lexical matches, and semantic matches to surface the most relevant recommendations in response to your queries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Collaborative filtering; Extreme multilabel classification; Learning to rank; Question answering; Recommender systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security, privacy, and abuse prevention
rubrics_metrics.description: Creating a secure suite of hardware, software, and services with privacy, while giving you control over your information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Cryptography; Differential privacy; Homomorphic encryption; Privacy-preserving machine learning; Truth and trust online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: Taking a broad, science-based approach to reach net zero carbon by 2040.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore more: Amazon Sustainability Report; Climate change; Decarbonization; Renewable energy; The Climate Pledge.
